title: Robust Identification of Cyclic Linear Systems from Shift Interventions under Contaminated Environments
banked_reason: Re-tiered from accepted on 2026-09-09: fully proved in Lean and originally accepted at field tier, but re-scored 6.9 under the recalibrated D0.5.G scale, below the 7.2 field bar; the mathematics was not refuted.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the sharp replacement-radius equivalence, both ambiguity directions, the generic and sparse-support frontiers, confidence-union coverage, and the stated non-effective four-margin contraction with no added assumptions or proof placeholders. Three reusable matrix substrates were coordinated into Causalean during F3, and F7 additionally promoted the finite-dimensional polynomial zero-locus nullity lemmas; executable quantifier elimination and software release logic remain explicitly outside the delivered theorem claims.
tldr: Unknown diagonal shift interventions identify a cyclic linear causal system because covariance differences share a non-unitary congruence diagonalizer. With as many as \(c\) arbitrary positive-semidefinite covariance slots, the BACKSHIFT-normalized structural matrix is uniquely recovered for every contamination exactly when deleting the largest affine-line subset from each pairwise honest shift cloud costs more than \(c\) environments; failure has a positive-definite ambiguity witness when the invariant noise lies in the positive-definite interior. The generic sparse-support frontier is an exact four-term incidence formula. Arbitrary nonempty positive-semidefinite covariance regions yield a set-theoretic simultaneous-coverage implication, and four true-side margins plus only candidate conditioning yield a non-effective local radius and an explicit linear contraction modulus. Executable quantifier elimination, exact generated union codes, effective radii, release-or-abstain decisions, normalization-chart automation, and a corruption-aware CRAN implementation remain open.
gap: Published BACKSHIFT identifies from an entirely honest environment family, general joint-diagonalization theory studies one complete matrix family, and existing outlier-aware joint diagonalization uses a tuning threshold without an exact adversarial radius.
fill: The project derives the necessary-and-sufficient distance \(\delta_H>c\), a matching positive-definite contamination witness satisfying the BACKSHIFT cycle-product normalization under the interior-noise condition, and the exact generic support-incidence formula. Finite subset enumeration is recorded only as a definitional feasibility-oracle implementation note. The open inference target asks for explicit operator-norm radius and modulus functions for indexed confidence unions on fixed-margin uniform classes, rational certificates, chart switching, and abstention at vanishing affine minors.
